newsitem.title: USA: CIPSCO Q1 hurt by weather, merger costs.
newsitem.headline: CIPSCO Q1 hurt by weather, merger costs.

text.p: CIPSCO Inc said Tuesday weather factors, costs associated with a corporate restructuring and a proposed merger and the timing of power station maintenance projects caused first quarter earnings to fall.
Milder-than-normal weather in the quarter compared to last year's considerably colder-than-normal weather, CIPSCO said.

In December 1995, shareholders of CIPSCO and Union Electric Co of St. Louis approved a merger of the two companies. The transaction is pending review by regulatory agencies and is expected to be completed by the end of 1997, CIPSCO said.
The utility Tuesday reported net income of $15.6 million, or $0.46 a share for the first quarter, compared to $21.1 million, or $0.62 a share a year ago.
CIPSCO shares closed unchanged at 34-1/4 Tuesday.
